current_view.compatibility: Additive opt-in extension; contract version unchanged. Older clients receive the original result. New clients fall back to reads if the optional view is absent.
current_view.response: include_current_view=true adds view_status=ready|refresh_required and current_view. Original mutation result remains immutable; current_view is rebuilt after commit or replay under the same lock and is never stored in the journal. Projection failure returns a successful mutation with refresh_required and null view.
current_view.practice: Same projection as GET practice, including generated_at. Used to render present state rather than the historical mutation result.
current_view.roster: Public roster returned when known_roster_version differs or roster_expires_at has expired. Cache hints never authorize a write. Browser validates season, binding and roster versions and absolute expiry.
current_view.management: Full protected members returned only when roster version differs; current member_links always returned. view_practice_id scopes member-edit readback, cannot change the mutation target.
current_view.retry: View preferences are excluded from the business payload digest. Unknown writes keep the original request ID and payload. An acknowledged write needing a view retries reads only. Late or wrong-entity views never replace newer visible data.

seating.compatibility: Additive fields and POST actions; contract version remains compatible while the older Pages client ignores seat_plan.
seating.public_projection: Every practice read may include seat_plan. It contains only the latest published or frozen revision, never the Coach draft. Coach and Steerer expose display names but not member IDs.
seating.management_projection: Protected seating workspaces contain the private draft, latest published revision, full-season member choices, pending confirmed members, server mode and edit boundary. Published Coach and Steerer roles also include member_id so reset can restore internal selections; frozen snapshots use the same public/management separation.
seating.versions: seat_plan_version protects the Coach draft; published_revision protects the public pointer. Signup mutations can advance both in the same recoverable journal plan.
seating.correction_window: At end_at, signup changes stop and FINAL_CORRECTION begins. Direct seat changes remain available strictly before archive_due_at=end_at+24 hours; the exact boundary is frozen even if a background trigger is late.

p1_management.notes: P1M journal stores a deterministic plan/result before writes; recovery runs under the same script lock before other work. The result is immutable; optional current_view is generated after commit/replay. view_status=reload_required still means the write succeeded. Retry reading, not creating a new write. Season completion is recorded at the exact effective boundary and only clears its own default pointer. Archive files remain P4.

transport.management_transport: POST body only; session_token is never placed in a URL

request.request_id: 8 to 128 ASCII letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens

getMemberWorkspace.notes: Reads a current or completed season management workspace under one lock. Published practices only; chooses the first if practice_id is omitted. Returns full members if version differs. A selected practice also returns its seating workspace, including an eligible final-correction window. VIEW_UNAVAILABLE is a retryable read failure, never evidence of a failed prior mutation.

practice.notes: Requires both a published practice and an opened week. Reads the latest signup and public seat-plan state, never a ten-minute training cache. Cancelled rows are excluded. Confirmed and waitlisted rows carry member_id, display_name, preference, status, queue_at, queue_sequence and waitlist_position. seat_plan never contains a private draft.

signup.notes: Creates or reactivates a cancelled signup with a new queue timestamp and sequence. Public identity is selected, not authenticated.

updateSignup.notes: Preserves the existing queue timestamp and sequence; identical preference is a no-op. Target-side capacity can produce WAITLISTED as a successful result.

listSeasonMembers.notes: Members include source_display_name, display_name_override, display_name, default_preference, status, member_version, and active_links. No raw responses or contact fields are returned.

setMemberStatus.notes: ACTIVE or INACTIVE. Deactivation is rejected while unfinished training associations remain.

bootstrap.notes: Returns only published practices. Draft weeks and unpublished additional practices are excluded.

members.notes: The shared server snapshot has one absolute ten-minute expiry and contains active public member fields only.

coachLogin.notes: The plain Coach Code is validated but never stored in a sheet or response.

coachConnectivityWrite.notes: P0-only protected write. It appends one idempotent system audit event and does not change season, member, practice, signup or seat data.

initializeSeason.notes: Revalidates the binding, initializes runtime tabs and the form-submit trigger, imports members, locks the binding and automatically opens the season.

updateTrainingWeek.notes: Creates or recovers a private week draft from active templates.

request_fields: optional open_date and open_time in season timezone
confirmTrainingWeek.notes: No opening time means immediate; otherwise use either ISO open_at or local open_date/open_time. Confirmation increments week_version. Scheduled publishing recovers the same accepted plan.

createPractice.notes: Creates a private practice in DRAFT/SCHEDULED/OPENED weeks, initially within the selected calendar week. Editing a SCHEDULED week invalidates its confirmation; an OPENED week needs individual additional-practice publication.

publishAdditionalPractice.notes: Publishes only the named additional practice.

getSeatingWorkspace.notes: Returns one published practice, its signup state, the private Coach draft, the latest public revision, full-season members and server-calculated UPCOMING, FINAL_CORRECTION, FROZEN or CANCELLED mode. A completed season remains readable while a practice correction window is open.

saveSeatPlanDraft.notes: Saves a complete private draft snapshot. change_kind is EDIT, UNDO or RESET_TO_PUBLISHED. Coach and Steerer may be the same member; neither can occupy a paddle seat. Before training, seat members must be active confirmed signups. During final correction any member of this season may reflect actual attendance.

publishSeatPlan.notes: Publishes an immutable revision. Before training, every confirmed signup must occupy exactly one seat and preference mismatches require an explicit acknowledgement bound to current versions. Final corrections do not change signups or run promotions.

setDefaultSeason.notes: Only an OPEN season; checks the global default setting version, preserves independent season links.

updateSeasonSchedule.notes: DRAFT/OPEN only, fixed season timezone and binding; reject dates excluding active practices or published history.

request_fields: for UPDATE: practice_date, start_time, end_time, timezone, location, address, optional map_url
previewPracticeChange.notes: Authenticated read; validates server time and computes a payload-bound preview. Rescheduling preserves the original publication week even across calendar weeks.

updatePractice.notes: Requires a fresh preview. Preserve signup queues and seating history; cancelled drafts remain tombstones, public cancellations remain visible. Invalidates any pending week confirmation.

cancelPractice.notes: Requires a fresh preview. Preserve signup queues and seating history; cancelled drafts remain tombstones, public cancellations remain visible. Invalidates any pending week confirmation.

p2_write_protocol: POST timeout is 30 seconds. Freeze request_id and all business parameters while the result is unknown. Completed requests return the original result even after later state changes; GET practice afterwards for current state. Unfinished plans recover under the shared script lock before subsequent reads/writes.
